crossRefs.note: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that…
The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;
and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by Yahweh’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat…
Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel…
because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
“Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned…
While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, Yahweh’s anger burned against the people, and…
The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.
The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by…
even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.
As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the…
Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; For these pine away, stricken…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!
translations.bsb: The people quarreled with Moses and said, “If only we had perished with our brothers before the LORD!
translations.kjv: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
translations.asv: And the people strove with Moses, and spake, saying, Would that we had died when our brethren died before Jehovah!
